name: OWA Heavyweight Championship
epitaph: OWA's top belt, created February 2016 and won on the federation's own first night: Tyler Chandler took an open battle royal on the 2 March 2016 Anarchy to become the inaugural champion. Its own ledger records exactly one reign, still running at 327 days when the record stops, and its own article calls it “the top-tier championship title in Orlando Wrestling Alliance.” Chandler defended it against Alex Madsen on the January 2017 return show and was billed to defend it against Hunter Gage inside a cage at Rage in the Cage.

name: OWA Women's Championship
epitaph: Crowned the same night as the Heavyweight title — Clarissa Evans won a fatal four-way on the 2 March 2016 Anarchy — and held by her for 322 days, the longest reign anywhere in OWA's own record. Erin Spencer-Wolfe took it in a six-pack challenge at the live event that restarted the federation in January 2017, then lost it 39 days later to Angelita Henderson inside a steel cage at Rage in the Cage. The federation's own championship ledger was never revised past that January live event and still names Spencer-Wolfe champion; Henderson's own bio, written after the fact, is the source for the title's actual outcome.

name: OWA Intercontinental Championship
epitaph: Created 18 January 2017 and won the same night by the federation's own owner: Mason Wolfe took a fatal five-way at an OWA live event to become the inaugural and only champion its ledger records. Its own article files it as OWA's third-tier title.

name: OWA Universal Championship
epitaph: Created October 2016 and first contested at the January 2017 live event, where Owen Grady beat Mitch McGillicutty for it. Its own article files it as OWA's second-tier title and describes a belt built as the reverse of the World Championship's — red strap, black lettering inside the die-cut W. Grady was carded to defend it against Adam Dunn inside a cage at Rage in the Cage.

name: OWA Tag Team Championship
notes: The belt's own championship page is a placeholder the wiki never filled in; the reign source is promotions/owa-orlando/archive/brett-edgar.html and the match is carded at promotions/owa-orlando/archive/rage-in-the-cage-2017.html.
epitaph: Its own championship page never got past the words “coming soon,” but the belt is real in the federation's own record: Brett Edgar's bio card names him and Shane Miller, as Made in Detroit, beating Jake Anderson & Duke Knight and the Connolly brothers in a triple-threat tornado steel-cage match on the Rage in the Cage kickoff to become the first-ever OWA Tag Team Champions. That is the only reign the record carries, and it is the only Rage in the Cage result the record carries at all.

name: OWA United Kingdom Championship
notes: The belt's own championship page is a placeholder the wiki never filled in; it is named and unveiled in promotions/owa-orlando/archive/thursday-night-anarchy.html and listed among the federation's championships in promotions/owa-orlando/archive/orlando-wrestling-alliance.html.
epitaph: Unveiled on the 23 January 2017 Anarchy by the general managers, alongside the announcement of a thirty-two-man tournament to fill it. No champion is recorded, no tournament bracket survives, and the belt's own page never got past the words “coming soon.”
